scientific_integrity: The finite-time Dirichlet-multinomial law and earlier one-colour waiting-time thresholds are credited to prior theory. Newness is restricted to the combined sharp multiquota tail and marked-law asymptotics and the exact quota-blindness/rigidity classification. No independent validation or priority certificate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of colours, fixed positive integer quotas, strictly positive fixed masses and unit reinforcement; no growing-dimension uniform rates or alternate reinforcement. The historical literature search is non-exhaustive.
title: Sharp multi-quota completion tails and quota-blindness rigidity in a Pólya urn
